text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Ah!? Shoot!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't take my eyes off Shakur?! And 
here I came to cheer for Doto-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Me too... But isn't that totally unfair?! 
I mean, coming out with that...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
When she runs like she's shouting, "I'm 
right here!"... you just can't look away, 
can you—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "...That's right. That is fine."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(It's full of noise. Yet, that's just 
fine...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I want to make a name in even bigger 
races. Yeah, the kind that even folks with 
no interest in racing will get hooked 
on――)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. Yes, that is the 
destination..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nothin' left to do but blow 'em away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa...! Shakur-san plotting something 
in the rain, what a picture! Godly! 
Gorgeous! A work of art!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...She really is so cool, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, obviously, of cour—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugheh?! Was that Doto-san's voice...!? 
U-Uhm, what did you just say...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I think this might be the first time I've 
ever seen Shakur-san look so happy~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, that's so cool...♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh! The bond... between roommates...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? Digital-san vanished...?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In the presence of great art, one can lose 
themselves completely.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That she vanishes the moment I appear is 
simply the natural law of this world!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: S-So that's how it was...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Doto, this is no time to 
be celebrating.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected interloper in a theater 
meant solely for us. I would understand if 
she aimed for the lead role, but she is a 
destroyer of the play itself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In the next Arima Kinen—we'll have to show 
everyone who the protagonist and their 
true rival really are!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...On my name as an Umamusume otaku! 
Arima... I must secure the front row at 
all costs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dripping wet in the rain, Air Shakur 
laughed to herself. She looked so 
dazzling... If it's her, she'll 
definitely—
choice_data_list:
(I can leave a strong impression on 
everyone's hearts)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Time to head into the 'Arima Kinen'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae"'s judgment was that it was 
"impossible." Yet through countless 
iterations, here we are...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no option other than running. I'll 
prove who's real.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next goal was decided: the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, Shakur! Welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I watched the broadcast of today's race! 
You were so cool!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that gave me the motivation to do 
my best for my debut too."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Our time is limited, after all. Every 
single race has to be magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Shakur. What can I do for you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you come to the racetrack for 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Since you're so fond of granting charity, 
"Your Highness," you'll accept this 
naturally, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Of course. ...Though, why do you ask?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's a witness, ain't there? One that's 
real easy to find...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A royal Highness prepared to martyr 
himself for destiny... Couldn't have asked 
for a better setup.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ... Shakur, what are you thinking?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Through and through, it's all about 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice, Fine. Once this is over, maybe 
for the first time... I can actually like 
you a little?
